body:
alisha: Hey team — I'm submitting my two-week notice today. Last day will be Fri 2026-06-05. Quick flag: I work remote (EU) and want to coordinate benefits end date, COBRA timeline, laptop return, and VPN/Slack deactivation timing so my support handoff isn't interrupted.
people-ops: Thanks for the heads up, Alisha. We'll run through checklist. Two quick Qs: do you want HR to schedule an exit interview and do you have an up-to-date handoff doc? :clipboard:
alisha: Yes please schedule the exit interview — morning of my last day would work. I uploaded a handoff doc to the team drive (link: https://drive.redwood/example-handbook). I'll update it this week.
it-ops: Noted. For hardware return, can you confirm which kit you have (laptop + dock + modem)? We'll generate an RMA label. Also when do you want VPN and Slack locked? Common practice is to keep Slack active until EOD last day and disable VPN at 6pm PT that day.
alisha: Laptop (MacBook Pro 14, company asset tag 8972), dock, no modem. Keeping Slack until EOD is fine. Can we deprovision service accounts earlier? I have an AWS role used for on-call rotations — need to hand that off to Eva
eva: I can pick up the AWS role. Alisha, can you leave the sts:AssumeRole policy in your handoff doc and list the critical runbooks you own?
alisha: Will do. I'll add exact role ARNs and runbook links.
security: Heads up — before we disable MFA we need a signed manager approval confirming that all secrets in your Keychain have been rotated or transferred. Can you confirm by Thu 2026-05-28?
mike: Confirming from manager side — I approve security to proceed once Alisha posts the runbook links and the asset return ticket is created. :white_check_mark:
payroll-bot: FYI payroll timeline: final paycheck will include any accrued PTO paid out per policy and will be processed on the next payroll cycle after termination. COBRA: benefit termination effective last day of employment (2026-06-05). COBRA election notice will be sent within 14 days; you have 60 days to elect coverage once notice is sent.
people-ops: To summarize action items:
- Alisha: update handoff doc with AWS role ARNs, runbooks, and remote access notes (by 2026-05-28)
- IT: create asset-return RMA and schedule pickup/dropoff (create ticket)
- Security: verify secret rotation and approve deprovision timeline (awaiting manager sign-off)
- Payroll/Benefits: initiate COBRA packet and confirm last-day benefits termination
offboard-bot: Generated offboarding checklist #OB-5691. Current status: pending (assets: 1, benefits: pending, exit-interview: not scheduled).
alisha: Quick policy Q — because I'm EU-based, will COBRA apply the same? I thought COBRA is US-specific.
people-ops: Good catch — COBRA is US federal. For international employees we follow local statutory continuation rules. We'll DM you to confirm which country-specific benefits wrap-up applies and next steps. :dm:
alisha: Thanks. One more ask: can IT whitelist Eva's IP for access to the staging cluster for the next 2 weeks while I finish handoffs?
it-ops: We can do a temporary allowlist. Please post the IP range and I'll add it for 14 days. Example command we use internally to remove after expiry:
```
# revoke access after 14 days
revoke_access --user alisha --resource staging-cluster --after 14d
```
mike: Also, please set your OOO calendar for the last day to include the exit interview time and a final handoff meeting at 2pm PT.
alisha: Will set calendar and populate handoff doc today. Appreciate the help everyone. :heart:
people-ops: Thanks Alisha — we'll follow up with DMs for the country-specific benefits and create the payroll/asset tickets by EOD.
